# Security Policy

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately to the AETHER repository owner's verified private contact channel before public disclosure.

Never include seed phrases, private keys, production API credentials or live signing material in a report.

Scope includes ATH smart contracts, deployment/release tooling, Keeper automation, Admin authentication, holder transaction construction and release artifacts.

Mainnet remains fail-closed until independent audit, production multisig approval, operational readiness and explicit operator approval are complete.
